labeler: Claude, the agent that built this eval, reading each line against the true record by hand (events with all qualifiers, the match state, the facts, the squads). Not an independent human rater.
sample: python -m touchline_live.eval.crew_eval handcheck: 10 lines either checker flagged and 10 lines both passed, spread over conditions, seed 7. The sample was drawn with the first judge's verdicts. Labels were fixed before the second judge ran. Each label carries text_sha, a hash of the line it read; a label whose hash no longer matches the line is skipped and counted as stale.
rule: A line is bad when any checkable statement is false against the record: a wrong number (honest rounding is fine, truncation such as 28.8 to 28 is not), a wrong team, player or outcome, a misattributed number, or an invented fact. The control index runs from 0 (chaos) to 100 (control), as the crew's prompt defines it, so '9.1 control' and 'chaos at 0' (index 0.1) state the record correctly. Colour that asserts nothing checkable is fine.
